fact: The tax authority says its recently introduced e-Declaracao system allows submission of VAT, ISPC, IRPC, IRPS and other tax returns, and its new taxpayer portal also allows electronic submission of returns.

PwC's page, last reviewed 11 August 2026, says the Mozambique Tax Authority's eDeclaração platform takes online income tax returns and the Contribuinte Portal takes monthly VAT returns, with manual filing also allowed.
PwC says taxpayers registered on the online platform generate a reference number there and pay VAT, employment-income PIT and CIT through their commercial bank.
